title: Forcefield XML -> lossless compressed protobuf format
body: Investigate how to losslessly convert OpenMM-style forcefield FFXML (proxide ships CHARMM36, Amber ff14SB/ff19SB, GAFF under src/proxide/assets/) into a compressed protobuf (.pb.zst), mirroring the rotlib.proto approach. Need to think through how to represent the different XML hierarchies and field sets across force fields: AtomTypes, Residues (atoms+bonds+external bonds), HarmonicBondForce, HarmonicAngleForce, PeriodicTorsionForce (proper+improper, multiple terms), NonbondedForce + exceptions, CMAP (CHARMM), virtual sites, water/ion variants. proxide_core::forcefield::{types,topology,xml_parser} already parses much of this into structs. Open questions: one unified schema vs per-FF-family schemas; how to preserve class-vs-type keying; ordering/round-trip fidelity; whether to share machinery with proxide-rotlib's rotlib.proto + zstd pipeline. Motivated by backlog #820 (rotlib geometry sourced from CHARMM36 FFXML) — having the FF in fast compressed protobuf would benefit both rotlib geometry generation and physics/MD param loading.
